title: For your soul sanity … from Tom Prasada-Rao

body:
Tom – wherever you are, thanks for sharing this gift with the world.

 And may you be strengthened and inspired to face your current challenges as you have strengthened and inspired so many of us through the years. Namaste.

 And may we all stand strong for Black Lives and against white supremacy, even when it tries to camouflage itself with a Bible. When Black lives matter to America, all lives will matter. Thirty pieces of silver … a $20 bill … the love of money (and the power it promises) is the root of all sorts of evil.

  

  

 If you’d like to help Tom – here’s how:

 https://www.gofundme.com/f/supporting-our-brother-tpr
